tolerance_policy: Half the 0.1 Gyr reporting unit; present age uses abstract precision, not Table 1 extra digits. Do not widen after execution.
prior: Published age targets should be recoverable without refitting. QLF mapping is undetermined.
exposure: Targets and fitted parameters known before specification; retrospective, not blind preregistration.
failure_policy: Any target failure blocks benchmark acceptance. Retain discrepancy; do not refit or relabel as a QLF exclusion.
